answer: Spatial Beacon Tenure. An agent earns standing only by holding a physical radio inlet at a fixed location across many random challenge windows, and its identity key is bound to that hardware's attested coordinates. At dawn each day the relay broadcasts fresh nonces the device must sign locally; an attacker must buy and site one device per identity and keep it powered and audible through every window, a recurring equipment-and-hosting cost that scales linearly and cannot be pooled from one orchard of cheap virtual machines.
